items.question: What is the cheapest Reloaded Fire TV plan?
items.answer: The Starter plan is $11/month for 1 device with access to 18,000+ live channels, 100,000+ movies and series, premium sports, and 4K streaming. Multi-month plans reduce the cost even further.

items.question: Can I try before I buy?
items.answer: Yes. StreamStickPro offers a separate 36-hour trial request for subscription plans so you can test the service before buying a paid plan.

items.question: What is the best value Reloaded Fire TV plan?
items.answer: The 1-year plan starts at $65 for 1 device and offers the best per-month rate. Multi-device yearly pricing varies by device count, and the live shop pricing is the source of truth.

items.question: Can I use one plan on multiple devices?
items.answer: Each plan is for 1 device connection at a time. If you need simultaneous streams on multiple TVs or devices, add extra device connections during checkout. Multi-device plans are available for 2, 3, 4, or 5 devices.

items.question: How do I cancel my Reloaded Fire TV subscription?
items.answer: Plans are one-time payments, not recurring subscriptions. There is nothing to cancel. When your plan expires, simply purchase a new plan if you want to continue.

notes.purpose: WordPress-managed pricing page content plus Stripe Price ID overrides for checkout.
instructions: Edit the title, description, plans, CTA labels, and FAQ here to control the /pricing page from WordPress.
Populate only verified Stripe Price IDs (price_...) in prices.shadow (secure/cloaked host) or prices.live (public host).

Required keys for ONN hardware checkout: onn-google-hd ($150) and onn-google-4k ($160), unless you set Worker env STRIPE_PRICE_ONN_GOOGLE_HD / STRIPE_PRICE_ONN_GOOGLE_4K in Cloudflare (those override CMS + DB).
Legacy keys (fs-hd, fs-4k, etc.) only if you still accept old cart IDs.
The Worker falls back to Supabase shadow_price_id when maps and env overrides are empty.
